Freelancer.com 和 We Work Remotely 的 RSS 可用。抓 Freelancer 的实际项目（含预算）。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "function strip(s){ return String(s||'').replace(/<!\\[CDATA\\[/g,'').replace(/\\]\\]>/g,'').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim(); }",
 "(async function(){",
 " const r=await get('https://www.freelancer.com/rss.xml');",
 " console.log('status', r.status, 'len', r.body.length);",
 " const items=r.body.split('<item>').slice(1);",
 " console.log('ITEMS:', items.length);",
 " for(const it of items.slice(0,20)){",
 " const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(it);",
 " const d=/<description>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/description>/.exec(it);",
 " const l=/<link>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/link>/.exec(it);",
 " const pd=/<pubDate>([^<]+)</.exec(it);",
 " console.log('--- '+strip(t?t[1]:'?'));",
 " if(pd) console.log(' 日期: '+pd[1].substring(0,16));",
 " console.log(' 描述: '+strip(d?d[1]:'').substring(0,300));",
 " if(l) console.log(' 链接: '+strip(l[1]));",
 " }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-fl.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-fl.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch Freelancer project feed", timeoutMs: 200000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 8000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
